title: Marry Me Chicken Orzo

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: or oil from the sun-dried tomatoes jar

ingredients.name: double cream
ingredients.note: heavy cream or thickened cream also works

steps: In a large, deep frying pan, heat the oil over a medium heat. When it is hot, carefully add the chicken pieces. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until all sides are starting to colour.
Reduce the heat and add the garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano and paprika. Stir for 3-5 minutes until the garlic is softened.
Add the orzo, stock and some pepper. Stir well, then put the lid on. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is almost cooked.
Turn the heat to the lowest setting. Add the spinach and cream, then stir very well for 1-3 minutes until the spinach is wilted and the cream is heated through. Check the chicken is cooked through.
Turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan.
